title: Hearty Robata-Grilled Russian Potato Salad
description: A fatty, creamy hangover‑cure Russian salad featuring garlic, egg yolks, and fresh dill, made on a robata grill for a smoky bite.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to medium-high heat, around 180°C.
Rinse the diced potatoes under cold water and pat dry with a towel.
Toss the potatoes with olive oil, butter, minced garlic, salt, and pepper until evenly coated.
Arrange the potato cubes on the grill grates and cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and crispy, about 15 minutes.
While the potatoes are grilling, whisk the egg yolks, sour cream, lemon juice, and chopped dill together in a bowl.
Remove the potatoes from the grill and transfer them to a large mixing bowl.
Drizzle the creamy dill mixture over the hot potatoes and fold gently until all pieces are coated.
Let the salad sit for 5 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Taste and adjust seasoning with extra salt or pepper if needed.
Serve immediately while warm, garnished with a few extra dill sprigs if desired.
